evidence_policy.documented: Fields/options/file hints are present in supplied evidence; this is clarification-ready, not live execution proof.
evidence_policy.documented_partial: Some fields are documented but route/output or optional behavior remains uncertain.
evidence_policy.unverified: No trustworthy schema was found; ask for live details and do not submit.
evidence_policy.live_verified: Reserved for a successful live submission plus terminal output inspection; none are marked so here.

global_user_fields.name: experimentName
global_user_fields.notes: Mandatory for every Boltpro submission. Preserve user value; if absent, propose a name and ask confirmation.

rules: Emit the stable clarification-v1 envelope with only missing or invalid user fields in missing_fields/fields.
Do not request or expose system-managed credentials and identifiers as ordinary UI inputs.
Do not submit while any required user field, exact enum, or required file/header check is missing or invalid.
Treat source-sheet aliases as allowed only when the record explicitly lists them; never invent a scientific value or file column.
This catalog is scoped to platform-tools mode and must not alter Omics routing or logging.

user_fields.name: n_samples
user_fields.notes: Hard constraint: integer greater than 16 (minimum 17). The UI/sample value is 20 and is the recommended normal minimum.

user_fields.name: file_format
user_fields.notes: `"csv"` or `"fasta"`; user-facing alias `format`. These and `n_samples` are the only user input fields.
user_fields.label: Output format

notes: Product sheet says n_samples should be greater than 16; exact backend boundary is not re-verified here.

user_fields.name: input_file_path
user_fields.notes: Platform path returned by `file_upload`; filename must end in `.pdb` or `.cif`.

user_fields.name: suffix
user_fields.notes: Ligand identifier appended to outputs; must match `^[A-Z]+-[A-Z]+-\d+$`, for example `D-LDP-501`.

user_fields.name: predict_ligand
user_fields.notes: Exact ligand identifier in the input structure, including chain ID, 3-letter ligand name, and residue number; same format as `suffix`.

user_fields.name: no_of_samples
user_fields.notes: Number of poses; minimum 10 and maximum 100. Send an integer, not a string.

user_fields.name: file_format
user_fields.notes: CSV is the supported output format.

user_fields.name: indices
user_fields.notes: Positions to mutate (e.g., `[5, 10]`) — must be array, not string

user_fields.name: mutaions_per_epoch
user_fields.notes: Number of mutations per round. **API TYPO: spell it `mutaions_per_epoch` (missing the "t")** — the backend rejects the correct spelling `mutations_per_epoch` with `Schema validation failed: Mutations per epoch is required`. The skill docs and most reference files will say `mutations_per_epoch` but the live API only accepts the misspelled form.

notes: Field spelling mutaions_per_epoch follows supplied product sheet.

user_fields.name: positions
user_fields.notes: Space-separated residue references such as I61 N40.

user_fields.name: pdb_path
user_fields.notes: Dimer complex containing only chains A and B.

notes: Output CSV columns documented as id, Sequences, DDG_values.

user_fields.name: input_path
user_fields.notes: Uploaded single `.pdb` antibody/complex structure or one `.zip` containing PDB structures. Raw sequences and local paths are invalid.

user_fields.name: chains_to_design
user_fields.notes: Non-empty list of one-character PDB chain IDs, for example `['H', 'L']`. Every chain must exist in every applicable input structure.

user_fields.name: residue_positions_to_design
user_fields.notes: Designed-chain IDs mapped to one-based residue selections such as `101-106,115,119-123`. Omit or send `{}` for full-chain design.

user_fields.name: generation_count
user_fields.notes: Sequences to generate per PDB; accepted range 1–10000. Use a small count for validation.

user_fields.name: model_type
user_fields.notes: Exact value `af2_multimer` or `boltz2`; choose it to match the archive producer.
